relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: The arrival of suzetrigine, the first selective Nav1.8 inhibitor to reach the market, has generated considerable excitement

relationships.subject: lidocaine
relationships.evidence_quote: Lidocaine, mexiletine, and lamotrigine all modulate voltage-gated sodium channels, including Nav1.8.

key_findings: Letter cautions that suzetrigine safety is not fully known: SCN10A (Nav1.8) polymorphisms are linked to PR/QT abnormalities and Brugada syndrome, and Nav1.8 appears in diseased heart and muscle.
Notes renal excretion and many cytochrome P450 interactions that complicate dosing.
